origin: Famous as the chart Florence Nightingale drew in 1858 to show the causes of soldiers' deaths in the Crimean War, so it's also called a Nightingale rose.
whenToUse: Cyclical data, such as by month or hour.
You show seasonality or a daily rhythm.
whenNotToUse: Precise value comparison (use a column chart).

alternatives.name: Radar Chart
alternatives.reason: Comparing several scores as a shape.

accessibility: Pointing at a slice shows its name and value in text.
White borders between slices separate their edges.
The table view lists every value.
